lead.event: Fortune Indonesia plans coal-miner acquisition financed by a rights issue
lead.headline: FORU plans 49% coal-miner acquisition through up to Rp27.10 trillion rights issue
lead.blurb: Fortune Indonesia has shareholder approval for a rights issue of up to 215.10 billion new shares at Rp126 each, potentially raising Rp27.10 trillion. About Rp20.81 trillion is earmarked for the 49% stake in Borneo Prima, with the remainder to be lent to the miner for working capital. Borneo Prima reported 87.7 million tons of reserves in its 2026 JORC report.

deals_control.event: Bayan Resources insiders sell shares after Haji Isam’s stake acquisition
deals_control.headline: BYAN insiders sell 666.67 million shares after Jhonlin’s 30.25% stake acquisition
deals_control.blurb: Bayan Resources’ Low Tuck Kwong and Elaine Low sold the shares at Rp2,588 each on 15 October, for about Rp1.73 trillion. Jhonlin Baratama, owned by Haji Isam, completed its stake acquisition on 7 October. Low’s voting stake fell to 8.30%, but he said he remains controller and will maintain control.

deals_control.event: Andry Hakim and Gabriel Rey acquire a 20% stake in Guna Timur Raya
deals_control.headline: Andry Hakim and Gabriel Rey acquire 20% of TRUK
deals_control.blurb: Gabriel Rey's Pukul Rata Kanan bought 15% at Rp428 a share for Rp27.9 billion, while Hakimson Growth Capital paid Rp9.3 billion for 5% at the same price. Andry said seller Catur Dharma Anugerah Surya is affiliated with CBRE, whose group had previously planned to acquire Guna Timur Raya.

earnings_guidance.event: Adira Finance reports profit growth and expects growth to continue through 2026
earnings_guidance.headline: ADMF reports 36.58% profit growth, expects it to continue through 2026
earnings_guidance.blurb: Adira Finance reported net profit of Rp1.12 trillion, supported by higher revenue from growth in average managed assets, lower funding costs and reduced impairment provisions. CFO Sylvanus Gani said it will maintain prudent financing, optimize operational efficiency and its funding mix, and preserve asset quality, while the BI rate at 5.75% could raise funding costs.

earnings_guidance.event: Multi Medika Internasional sets revenue-growth targets for late 2026 and 2027
earnings_guidance.headline: MMIX targets Rp473 billion in 2027 revenue
earnings_guidance.blurb: Multi Medika Internasional expects 12%-15% revenue growth in Q4/2026 and targets 2027 EBITDA of Rp116 billion, versus Rp88 billion in 2026. It attributes growth to its new diaper plant in Legok, Tangerang.

earnings_guidance.event: Eastparc Hotel reports nine-month 2026 profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: EAST reports 8.63% nine-month profit growth to Rp22.79 billion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Eastparc Hotel's revenue fell 3% to Rp64.94 billion, while operating profit rose to Rp26.79 billion from Rp24.82 billion as cost of revenue and operating expenses declined. Results included a Rp1.07 billion gain from disposing of digital assets.
